ob.welcomeTitle: Don't think about what to wear today.
ob.welcomeSubtitle: Learn the weather for your location and see today's outfit right away.
ob.privacyBody: Your location is only used to fetch weather. Your coordinates (or the city you pick) are sent to the weather provider Open-Meteo.com. We don't create accounts and never ask for your name or identity. Your preferences are stored only on your phone. Official alert links open the relevant institutions' websites, which have their own privacy terms. You can withdraw your consent anytime in Settings.
ob.privacyDetailsBody: The app sends your location (or the coordinates of the city you search for) only to the Open-Meteo weather forecast service. Your location stays on your device; nothing is sent to our servers. Official alert links open sites like MGM, governed by their own privacy terms. If you allow notifications, only a local reminder is scheduled at the time you choose; its content is generated from the latest weather forecast. You can delete all your data in Settings > Privacy.
ob.declineMsg: We understand. The app can't work without location and weather; you can go back to the welcome screen if you like.
ob.locationBody: Let's fetch the weather for where you are. If you don't grant permission, you can continue by searching for a city.
ob.coldBody: Pick what fits you best so we can suggest the right outfit. You can change it anytime in Settings.
ob.notifBody: Want an outfit reminder at the time you pick? Mornings show today's look, evenings tomorrow's.

info.title: How suggestions work
info.subtitle: Each day's outfit suggestion comes from a few simple inputs.
info.weatherBody: Open-Meteo hourly and daily forecast; feels-like temperature accounts for wind and humidity.
info.placeBody: GPS or the city you pick. Coordinates are only sent to Open-Meteo for weather data.
info.coldBody: The “How do you feel?” setting in Settings personalizes suggestions; time of day and transport are also considered.
info.learnBody: Pieces you reject and a learned fine temperature offset improve suggestions over time.
info.footer: No made-up data — every suggestion is generated from the real forecast.
